messages:
frank: Quick thread — building the "onramp governance" checklist for tenant isolation (multi-region). Want to keep it super actionable for sales + eng.
anya: please include explicit contract gates (reserved commit, uplift bands) and a simple yes/no handoff for deals.
leah: infra: must have automated evacuation + canary plan. proof point: one dry-run runbook that shows <2% error.
oscar: product note: console should surface "isolation tax" estimate before customer signs. show percent uplift and example cost calc.
frank: proposed minimal gates:
- automation: staged tenant deploy + evacuation dry-run
- telemetry: per-request routing_decision + token_cost emitted
- perf: agreed p50/p95 targets and regression thresholds
- quality: fallback model variants and regression suite pass
- commercial: uplift bands + reserved commit options documented
- legal: residency & egress addendum signed
anya: also add an opt-out boolean for fallbacks that sales can set (client may forbid automatic downgrades).
leah: telemetry fields to capture in pilot: token_cost_usd, kv_cache_hit, chosen_model_variant, fallback_reason, sequence_length_tokens.
oscar: rollout: internal -> 2 invited customers -> small cohort -> GA. metric gates at each step.
sre-bot: scheduled: "Isolation Onramp Dry-run" Tue 09:00. Logs will be posted to #runbooks. :calendar:
frank: action items: leah to create dry-run PR (Mon), anya to draft sales handoff one-pager (Thu), oscar to add cost calc examples (Wed).
